description:
Search your knowledge base by meaning and keywords.

        Use this FIRST when a question might be answered by content already
        stored in Soloclef Notes — notes, uploaded files, saved pages, past
        research. It reads only what is already stored and fetches nothing
        new from the web. Returns the most relevant documents with the
        passages that matched, ranked by relevance score.
        Example: query='pricing feedback', top_k=5.

document_types.description: Restrict to these document types, e.g. ['FILE', 'CRAWLED_URL', 'YOUTUBE_VIDEO']. Omit for all types.
document_types.title: Document Types

name: soloclef_search_knowledge_base
title: Search knowledge base

description:
List documents in your knowledge base, newest first.

        Use this to browse or inventory what is stored; to find documents
        about a topic, prefer soloclef_search_knowledge_base. Returns each
        document's title, id, type, and update time, plus a has_more flag —
        request the next page by increasing page.
        Example: document_types=['FILE'], page=0, page_size=20.

document_types.description: Restrict to these document types, e.g. ['FILE', 'CRAWLED_URL', 'YOUTUBE_VIDEO']. Omit for all types.
document_types.title: Document Types

folder_id.description: Only documents in this folder. Omit for all.
folder_id.title: Folder Id

name: soloclef_list_documents
title: List documents

description:
Read one document's full content and metadata by id.

        Use this after soloclef_search_knowledge_base or
        soloclef_list_documents to open a specific document — search results
        only include the matching passages, this returns the whole text.
        The markdown form is an Open Knowledge Format (OKF) concept: a YAML
        frontmatter block (type, title, tags, resource, timestamp) followed by
        the document body.

document_id.description: Document id from soloclef_search_knowledge_base or soloclef_list_documents results.
document_id.title: Document Id

name: soloclef_get_document
title: Read one document

description:
Save a text or markdown note into your knowledge base.

        Use this to store notes, summaries, or findings so they become
        searchable later — e.g. after finishing a piece of research. For files
        on disk use soloclef_upload_file instead. Indexing is asynchronous,
        so the note may take a moment to appear in search.
        Example: title='NotebookLM subreddits', content='- r/notebooklm ...'.

content.description: The note's body; plain text or markdown.
content.title: Content

source_url.description: Where the text came from, if anywhere.
source_url.title: Source Url

title.description: Short descriptive title for the note.
title.title: Title

name: soloclef_add_document
title: Add a note

description:
Upload a local file (PDF, docx, markdown, etc.) into the knowledge base.

        Use this to ingest a file from disk so its content becomes searchable;
        for text you already have in hand use soloclef_add_document instead.
        The file is parsed, chunked, and indexed asynchronously. Duplicate
        files are detected and skipped.
        Example: file_path='C:/Users/me/report.pdf'.

file_path.description: Path to a local file, e.g. 'C:/Users/me/report.pdf' or '~/notes/summary.md'.
file_path.title: File Path

use_vision_llm.description: True reads scanned or image-heavy files with a vision model (slower).
use_vision_llm.title: Use Vision Llm

name: soloclef_upload_file
title: Upload a file

description:
Replace a document's stored content by id.

        Use this to correct or rewrite a document's text. The new content
        REPLACES the old entirely — to append, read the document first with
        soloclef_get_document and resend the combined text. The document
        re-indexes in the background afterwards.

content.description: New full text; replaces the existing content entirely.
content.title: Content

document_id.description: Document id from soloclef_search_knowledge_base or soloclef_list_documents results.
document_id.title: Document Id

name: soloclef_update_document
title: Replace a document's content

description:
Permanently delete a document from the knowledge base by id.

        Use this only when the user explicitly asks to remove a document —
        deletion cannot be undone. The document stops appearing in searches
        immediately.

document_id.description: Document id from soloclef_search_knowledge_base or soloclef_list_documents results.
document_id.title: Document Id

name: soloclef_delete_document
title: Delete a document

description:
Search PubMed (biomedical literature) by keyword.

        Returns, per paper: title, authors, year, journal, PMID/PMCID/DOI, the
        PubMed URL, and an abstract (or a full-text excerpt when
        full_text=True and the paper is in PMC's open-access subset).
        Example: query='bronchiolitis high flow nasal cannula', since=2018.

full_text.description: When true, read PMC open-access full text for the top hits (where available) and return an excerpt instead of just the abstract.
full_text.title: Full Text

name: soloclef_pubmed_search
title: Search PubMed

description:
Search arXiv (preprints: physics, CS, math, stats, and more).

        Returns, per paper: title, authors, year, arXiv id, DOI/journal-ref
        when published, the arXiv URL, and the abstract.
        Example: query='transformer attention mechanism'.
name: soloclef_arxiv_search
title: Search arXiv

description:
Search medRxiv (health sciences) or bioRxiv (biology) preprints.

        These are NOT peer reviewed. Returns, per preprint: title, authors,
        year, DOI, the landing-page URL, and the abstract.
        Example: query='pediatric asthma exacerbation', server='medrxiv'.
name: soloclef_preprint_search
title: Search medRxiv / bioRxiv
